title: Total Insulin/Carb ratio in extra status line
body: Please extend the new "extra line status" options for total carbs and total insulin to include another (and last) option for the ratio of those two.  carbs/insulin. For example if the total carbs for last 24 hrs is currently 100 and total insulin is currently 15 then this new option would show 6.67.

comments.body: I modified the above request to swap the values in the ratio to put carbs in the numerator and insulin in denominator.  Makes more sense.  Most folks relate to a "carb to insulin ratio" and not the other way around.
Should be present in the March 27th Nightly, please check and let me know if it is correct. Thanks.

I've upgraded to the 3/27 build and things look good.  Thanks for the
inclusion!
-r
